blocks.text: Somānanda's great contribution here is to insist that divine freedom cannot be reduced to overt action.
blocks.directed: Somānanda's great contribution here is to insist that divine freedom cannot be reduced to overt action.

blocks.section: 27. The final insight - Even while Śiva rests, the universe
blocks.text: The absence of a visibly manifested universe doesn't mean Śiva has lost the power of will.
blocks.directed: The absence of a visibly manifested universe doesn't mean Śiva has lost the power of will.

blocks.section: 27. The final insight - Even while Śiva rests, the universe
blocks.text: And the absence of gross physical activity doesn't mean divine agency has become nonexistent.
